race.description: Outkast National Design & Construction Trotters Mbl
race.comment: SQUAMISH (5) did a good job to finish in the minor placings two runs back then got the standing start wrong last time. Better off behind the mobile so can bounce back. LEAF STRIDE NZ (6) switches to the Shawn Grimsey yard from NSW where he was last seen finishing fourth at Group Three level at Menangle. Draws wide but his best form measures up. DAIMYO (4) was runner-up from this barrier two back then scored by 3 metres last time, taking his record at this circuit and distance to three from five. Big chance again. LAYDOWNLUNA (3) worked and faded last time but had put together a string of wins or placings prior so is worth another chance.
